labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Reduces friction between bones and permits normal movement

labels.name: Joint mouse
labels.function: Free fragment of bone and cartilage that blocks motion

labels.name: Synovial membrane
labels.function: Lining that encloses the lubricated cavity between bones

labels.name: Subchondral sclerosis
labels.function: Hardened, thickened bone ends after the overlying layer dies

labels.name: Joint space narrowing
labels.function: Thinning of the gliding layer lets bone rub on bone

labels.name: Osteophyte
labels.function: Spur from disordered repair; enlarges joint, causes locking

labels.name: Subchondral cyst
labels.function: Fluid-like encased sac that forms within bone

labels.name: Hyperplastic synovium
labels.function: Thickened lining forming villi; secretes destructive proteases

labels.name: Lymphoid aggregate
labels.function: Dense infiltrate of T cells, B cells and plasma cells

labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Hyaline layer destroyed by proteases in this disease

labels.name: Synovial fluid
labels.function: Cloudy yellow; 5,000-25,000 WBC/mm3, mostly neutrophils

labels.name: Macrophage
labels.function: Releases TNF-alpha, IL-1 and IL-6

labels.name: Pannus
labels.function: Granulation-tissue mass that creeps over the joint surface

labels.name: Bone erosion
labels.function: Marginal defect seen on RA hand and foot radiographs

labels.name: Osteoclast
labels.function: Driven by RANKL on activated T cells; resorbs bone

labels.name: DIP joint
labels.function: Typically spared in RA

labels.name: PIP joint
labels.function: Hyperextended in swan neck, flexed in Boutonniere

labels.name: MCP joint
labels.function: Fingers drift into ulnar deviation here in RA

labels.name: Wrist
labels.function: Small joints here swell symmetrically in RA

labels.name: Heberden node
labels.function: Firm bony OA nodule at the joint nearest the fingertip

labels.name: Bouchard node
labels.function: Firm bony OA nodule at the middle joint of the finger

labels.name: Rheumatoid nodule
labels.function: Subcutaneous lesion: central necrosis, palisaded macrophages
